slides.headlineRest: Patched by SAP, Including Remote Code Execution
slides.body: SAP has released urgent patches for four critical vulnerabilities, all receiving the maximum CVSS score of 10.0. These severe flaws, found in SAP NetWeaver and Web Dispatcher, could allow attackers to exploit systems remotely without requiring any login credentials. Notably, two of these issues enable full remote code execution, posing an immediate and significant threat. Organizations are strongly advised to apply these security patches without delay to protect their SAP environments.
